sources.title: Visa Information: Barbados
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Republic of Maldives
sources.officialityEvidence: The Maldives Foreign Ministry's live country-specific consular page directly states the Barbados treatment for Maldivian passport holders and links Barbados Immigration for further details.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Maldivian passport holders are exempt from the visa requirement when visiting Barbados for a short-term stay of up to 6 months.

policies.title: Maldivian ordinary passports: Barbados short-visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: The Maldives Foreign Ministry's current Barbados-specific guidance exempts Maldivian passport holders from the visa requirement for short stays up to six months.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Maldivian passport holder visiting Barbados for a short stay of up to six months.
The cited guidance establishes visa exemption only; employment, residence, study, transit, crew, diplomatic, official and special-document treatment are outside scope.
The source directs travellers to Barbados Immigration for additional current entry requirements and final admission remains outside this visa classification.
